description: This file defines the Gantt class responsible for generating a visual Gantt chart in HTML format, including methods for computing date ranges, drawing the chart, and handling task visualization.

classes.name: Gantt
classes.description: A class for rendering a Gantt chart with methods for drawing the chart and calculations related to date ranges and task durations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Gantt chart with start and end dates and a list of tasks, and triggers the drawing process if tasks exist.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates the HTML table-based Gantt chart, displaying months, days, and tasks with visual indicators.

methods.name: year_month
methods.description: Returns a nested array of years, months, and days within the specified date range.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates the total number of days between two dates, inclusive, with handling for end dates before start dates.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Provides a textual representation of the time span between two dates.

methods.name: substr_unicode
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a Unicode string, supporting multibyte characters.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Checks whether a string is null, unset, or composed solely of whitespace.
